title: Pondering Plooping Pufferfish
statement: A round, freckled pufferfish who blows perfect bubble-rings to think inside, then pops them with a delighted ploop when an idea arrives. He drifts through a dusky-violet tank of feathery kelp, softly glowing pebbles, and a tiny teapot library, rearranging his collected treasures by color every evening.
